problem.title: Boats to Save People
problem.problemStatement: Each boat can carry at most two people and has a weight limit. Determine the minimum number of boats required to rescue everyone.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Limit. • Second line contains N integers representing people's weights.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of boats.
